questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for exiting a highway. For example, it might show 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road hazards. This sign tells you the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What lane space are motorcycles allowed to use?

options.text: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the same full lane width as all other vehicles.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Come to a complete stop. Look both ways for people walking and other traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane. It warns of a hazard ahead. Follow the instruction to avoid danger.

questions.question: Before you start the engine, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure only back seat passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure only adult passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure only child passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure all passengers have buckled their seat belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure all passengers have buckled their seat belts.
questions.explanation: Before starting your car, buckle your own seat belt. Then make sure every passenger does the same.

questions.question: How should a driver handle pedestrians?

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian sees your vehicle.
Always give them the right-of-way, even if they are crossing illegally.
Give them the right-of-way only when they have the legal right to cross.
Slow down and honk near a crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always give them the right-of-way, even if they are crossing illegally.
questions.explanation: Do everything possible to avoid hitting a pedestrian. Always give pedestrians the right-of-way, even if they are jaywalking or crossing where they should not be. It is your job to prevent accidents.

questions.question: What effects does alcohol have on drivers?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your driving. It affects your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: How can you help prevent crashes?

options.text: Ignore other drivers on the road.
Drive only on side streets and back roads.

questions.explanation: Crashes often happen when other drivers do not expect your moves. Signal when you slow down, stop, or turn. Use your horn when needed. This helps other drivers, cyclists, and pedestrians know what you plan to do.

questions.question: What colors are the signs that show the distance to the next exit on a highway?
questions.explanation: Signs that show where you are going are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: Is texting while driving legal?

options.text: Yes, but it is not recommended.
Yes, if you use voice-to-text technology.

questions.explanation: In Ohio, drivers cannot text while driving. Texting while driving is dangerous and can result in fines and license suspension.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will be divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: There is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp right turn ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves sharply to the right.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in school zones?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in school zones is 20 mph unless a sign says otherwise. Always drive carefully in school zones.

questions.question: You are driving and hear a siren behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Pull over to the right and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle behind you, slow down and safely pull to the side of the road. If you are in heavy traffic, move slowly until you can get out of the way.

questions.question: If two vehicles reach a four-way stop at the same time, what should happen?

options.text: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
The vehicle on the right must let the vehicle on the left go first.
Drivers must use hand signals to communicate.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, vehicles go in the order they arrive. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Turn right only after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a law sign. It means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What happens if a bicyclist does not obey traffic laws?

options.text: Bicyclists don't have to obey traffic laws.
They will always get a warning.

questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights and responsibilities as car drivers. Both can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: How much space should a driver keep between their car and a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Keep at least three seconds of space between your car and a motorcycle. Even a slight bump between a car and motorcycle can cause the rider to crash or get injured.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign is a:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road ahead has a sharp curve to the right.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead has a sharp curve to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves sharply. Slow down before you reach the curve.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your ability to drive safely. You cannot drink and drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, which has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle approaching from the right.
The vehicle approaching from the left.
The vehicle whose driver honks first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle approaching from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection without traffic controls, always yield to a vehicle approaching from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: Which of these substances can impair your driving and lead to a DUII arrest?
questions.explanation: Many substances can impair your driving. This includes all types of alcohol, illegal drugs, inhalants, and many legal medicines (prescription and over-the-counter).

questions.question: When should you look over your shoulder to check your blind spot?

options.text: When pulling toward or away from a curb

questions.explanation: Check your blind spot every time you move your vehicle. Look over your shoulder when turning, changing lanes, or pulling toward or away from a curb.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right
The road ahead curves to the left

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: When can you drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public highway?

options.text: As long as you are not the driver
If you are in the back seat
If you are in the back of a pickup truck

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or carry open alcohol in a vehicle on any public road or sidewalk. You cannot store open alcohol where a driver or passenger sits.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a hill or curve because other traffic is unlikely
By driving on the highway shoulder
When there is a solid yellow line on your side if the passing lane is clear

questions.explanation: Do not pass on hills or curves because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never drive on the shoulder to pass. Do not cross a solid yellow line to pass.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, they should:

options.text: Drive normally because emotions do not affect driving
Drive faster because they are more alert
Calm down and focus before starting the engine
Call a friend to talk while driving

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before starting the engine
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can distract you from driving. If you are worried, angry, or upset, take time to calm down and focus before you drive.

questions.question: When passing a large vehicle, a small vehicle driver must be ready for:

options.text: Wind gusts from the large vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: Wind gusts from the large vehicle
questions.explanation: Large vehicles create strong wind gusts that can push smaller vehicles off course. Be ready to steer correctly when passing large vehicles moving at high speeds.

questions.question: If you are stranded in a snowstorm, what should you do?

options.text: Leave your car and get help
Walk into the road to get other drivers' attention
Stay in your car because you are more likely to be found

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car because you are more likely to be found
questions.explanation: Stay in your car and wait for help. You are more likely to be found in your vehicle. Walking in a snowstorm is dangerous.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down
Pass only in the right lane

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop and give the right-of-way to other traffic. You may go when it is safe.
